verdict.rationale: Proton Pass stores TOTP codes inside saved login items (docs-5), so tokens live in the user's vaults rather than on the device. Its import and export tools (encrypted ZIP/JSON, unencrypted ZIP, CSV) offer a documented way to move data, but nothing describes a single guided transfer to a new phone. The pack never explicitly says that signing in on a new device brings all tokens over automatically, so the one-step path is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of cross-device sync or a guided new-phone setup carrying TOTP tokens, and hands-on or independent confirmation that tokens arrive intact on a new device.
